thread:
sasha: Heads up 1: eu-west1 embeddings returning intermittent 502/504s since 02:03. Triage points to a model fallback to a legacy quantized artifact during scaling. Proposing an emergency hotfix: swap to stable-model-v3 and tighten worker timeouts. Need expedited approval to shortcut canary.

deploybot: Preflight summary: CI: ✅, E2E: 9/10 (one flaky test unrelated), infra-check: ✅, audit-log: present. Emergency deploy command: 
```sh
./infra/deploy --svc embeddings --region eu-west1 --image ghcr.io/redwood/embeddings@sha256:beefcafed00d --mode emergency
```

rachel: Whats the blast radius? Any cross-region traffic shifts?

ops-oncall: Impact: 12-20% 502 rate on POST /v1/embeddings in eu-west1 over last 15m. Retries causing downstream queueing; cost spike noted. No cross-region failover currently triggered.

sasha: No schema/data changes. Model binary swap only. Changelog: "hotfix: swap -> stable-model-v3, reduce worker timeout to 7s, kv-cache ttl 120s". Image sha: beefcafed00d.

devx: Emergency policy requires both oncall + ops-lead approval. Please acknowledge with the exact phrase: "I approve emergency cutover". Also specify rollback trigger (metric + timeframe).

jen: I approve emergency cutover  - I'll stay with logs and traces.

ops-lead: Approving for eu-west1 only. Rollback condition: if 502 > 3% sustained for 5m OR P50 latency increases > 300ms. Auto-rollback command preloaded. Keep traffic steering to eu-central open.

sasha: Rollback cmd: 
```sh
kubectl rollout undo deploy/embeddings -n prod --to-revision=stable-2026-03-08
```

deploybot: E2E gated test passing restored: 10/10. Proceeding with emergency rollout: override canary -> 50% initial batch, 5m observe, then 100% if healthy.

ops-oncall: Dashboarding live. Alert thresholds set for 502 and p50.

rachel: +1 from product; customers in eu-west1 were hitting failures. Please add a short customer-facing note post-deploy.

sasha: Kicking off now. Deploy logs: "pull image beefcafed00d -> creating 6 new pods -> draining old pods"

deploybot: 3m checkpoint: initial batch 50% healthy, errors down to 6%, p50 260ms.

jen: Traces look good; embeddings quality spot-checked fine.

ops-oncall: 8m into rollout: error rate 2.4%, latency 205ms. Ready to scale to 100%.

deploybot: Scaling to 100% now. Observability: streaming health metrics.

ops-oncall: Post-scale: 1.7% 502s, p50 180ms. No new alerts.

devx: Reminder: document this in #release-notes and create brief blameless incident ticket with RCA timeline.

ops-lead: Good catch and fast coordination. Add CI gating for model artifact promotion to prevent accidental reverts.

sasha: Draft release note: "hotfix (eu-west1): emergency hotpatch swapping to stable-model-v3 to mitigate intermittent 502/504s; tightened timeouts and cache TTLs." Will publish after this thread.

deploybot: Emergency window closed. All health checks green.

jen: Filing ticket RD-2301 with timeline and next actions.

rachel: Thanks everyone. Keep monitoring for 30m.

ops-oncall: Will watch for 1h; will reopen thread if any regression.

sasha: Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
